verdict.rationale: The pack's only relevant items are bare page titles for a Datadog Watchdog™ docs page and a Monitors docs page, with no content showing that either detects anomalies or outliers without hand-set thresholds. This is a glancing signal at most. Missing for 10: any documented description of anomaly or outlier monitor types, how they are enabled, how they learn baselines without manual thresholds, and independent or hands-on corroboration that they surface real problems.
